why_ai: Registered brokers and FCM risk officers carry personal accountability and hedgers pay for a broker they trust, but execution, statements and reporting are already automated.
why_clarity: Fills, margin and segregation are exact and recur daily, though hedge advice and credit calls follow judgement rather than a rulebook.
why_digital: Orders, positions and statements are fully electronic; agricultural clients still choose a local broker by relationship and NFA registration limits offshore providers.

why_ai: Clearing needs an FCM balance sheet and accountable officers whatever AI does, though margin and collateral optimisation automate well.
why_clarity: Margin, capital charges and client returns are computed by codified rules every day and checked against settlements.
why_digital: Positions, margin and collateral move electronically between funds, FCMs and clearing houses, sold to institutions remotely.

why_ai: Hedgers rely on a trusted broker and an FCM willing to finance margin through a rally, which keeps relationships and credit judgement human.
why_clarity: Hedge ratios and margin are measurable, but whether advice was good shows only when the crop or cattle are sold.
why_digital: Clearing is electronic, but positions, cash contracts and advice move by phone and paper through farm-town offices.

why_ai: Farmers hedge through a broker they know personally, and that relationship is what keeps them hedged through margin calls.
why_clarity: Each farm's plan differs by acres, insurance and lender, and the outcome is known only at harvest.
why_digital: Advice is given by phone and at kitchen tables to local clients, with positions assembled from paper and portals.

why_ai: Financing an elevator's margin through a spike needs an FCM balance sheet and an accountable credit officer, while reconciliation automates.
why_clarity: Futures and cash-contract positions reconcile daily by commodity and month against an objective position report.
why_digital: Futures and grain-accounting data are digital; the relationship with elevators and their lenders is regional.

why_ai: Parsing statements and computing payouts is rule-bound document work that AI-native software can do end to end.
why_clarity: Commission splits and fee pass-throughs follow written schedules and tie out to the FCM's payment every month.
why_digital: Statements, trade files and payouts are entirely electronic and the work can be done remotely.

why_ai: Producers buy protection through a broker or agent they trust who knows their operation, though the instrument comparison itself automates.
why_clarity: LRP and option costs are published daily and comparable, but the outcome per lot is known only at sale.
why_digital: Coverage prices and orders are digital; producers are served locally by phone and in person.

why_ai: Exposure measurement and hedge documentation are automatable, though hedge policy and board reporting need a trusted adviser.
why_clarity: Exposures and hedge effectiveness are measurable each quarter, while hedge ratios remain a policy judgement.
why_digital: Purchasing data, orders and documentation are digital; companies still pick a broker through regional relationships.

why_ai: A registered associated person is personally accountable for recommendations, and farm clients follow the person, not the firm.
why_clarity: Daily tasks recur on the crop calendar, but advice quality is judged at harvest and varies by broker.
why_digital: The broker works on screens and phones, but clients are local farms reached by relationship.

why_ai: A codified daily computation from data feeds is a prime automation target, though a controller still signs and answers to the DSRO.
why_clarity: Rule 1.32 defines the computation exactly, it recurs every business day, and it either ties out by noon or does not.
why_digital: Bank, clearing-house and back-office data in, regulatory filings out, all electronic.

why_ai: Re-rating each trade against fee schedules and agreements is mechanical matching that software substitutes directly.
why_clarity: Every fee has a schedule or agreement and each line either matches or breaks, across millions of trades.
why_digital: Trade files, fee notices and invoices are all electronic and the work is location-independent.

why_ai: A named testifying expert carries personal accountability under cross-examination in adversarial, novel cases.
why_clarity: Each case differs and methods are contested between experts, though event studies and damages models follow recognised steps.
why_digital: Order-book data analysed on screens and delivered as reports, with testimony in person and work won through counsel relationships.

why_ai: Cargo inference from AIS is model-driven and reproducible by well-funded rivals, though analyst judgement on grades and destinations persists.
why_clarity: Flow estimates recur daily for thousands of voyages and are graded against EIA weekly and customs releases.
why_digital: Vessel signals and customs data in, data feeds and platforms out, sold to clients worldwide.

why_ai: Clients pay for named analysts' views on contested balances, but much of the balance-building is automatable from public data.
why_clarity: Balances and forecasts are graded by official releases, though methods differ between houses.
why_digital: Public statistics and licensed flows in, reports and analyst calls out, sold globally.

why_ai: AI weather models now rival physics models, which threatens a product built on interpreting shared model output.
why_clarity: Forecasts are issued daily and verified against observations within days.
why_digital: Model output in, forecasts and commentary out, delivered online to traders anywhere.

why_ai: Regulated margin models need accountable risk officers and novel judgement in stress, with demand set by law rather than by AI.
why_clarity: Margin methodology is documented and backtested daily, though stress events are rare and different each time.
why_digital: Position and price data in, margin rates out, inside a regulated utility with a few members' committees.

why_ai: Boards and CFOs pay for a trusted adviser on hedge policy, though exposure modelling and documentation automate.
why_clarity: Programmes differ by client and their value shows over budget cycles, not quickly.
why_digital: Client data analysed on screens and delivered as reports, sold through relationships.

why_ai: Self-regulatory investigations and FCM examinations need accountable staff making adversarial calls under statute.
why_clarity: Surveillance rules are written, but each investigation differs and outcomes take months.
why_digital: Order-book and filing data reviewed on screens, with on-site FCM examinations.

why_ai: Market commentary and education content are what general AI produces cheaply, though the exchange's own data stays unique.
why_clarity: Research topics vary and their value to volume growth is hard to measure.
why_digital: Exchange data in, published research and data products out, all online.

why_ai: Pattern detection on order data is model work open to AI-native rivals, though regulators expect explainable alerts.
why_clarity: Alerts recur at volume, but whether an alert was true misconduct is rarely confirmed.
why_digital: Client trade data in, software and alerts out, sold and supported remotely.

why_ai: Federal enforcement needs accountable officials making adversarial, high-stakes decisions, with demand set by statute.
why_clarity: Surveillance methods are documented, but cases are novel and resolve over years.
why_digital: Trader and order data analysed on screens; enforcement involves testimony and hearings.

why_ai: Subscribers follow a trusted adviser's voice, but generic market commentary is easily produced by AI.
why_clarity: Recommendations are judged by eventual price, and advisers differ in method.
why_digital: Market data in, newsletters and hotlines out, sold to farmers by subscription.

why_ai: Farm lenders decide on known borrowers with accountable credit officers and local relationships.
why_clarity: Credit policy is written, but hedge-line decisions arrive irregularly and resolve at harvest.
why_digital: Borrower files and draws are digital, but lending runs through local offices and farm visits.

why_ai: Each acquisition thesis is novel and consequential, but deal analysis is screen work.
why_clarity: Episodic deals, each unique, with client retention known years later.
why_digital: Internal analysis on screens, with negotiation that benefits from presence.

why_ai: Entrenched platforms are sticky, but their functions are software that AI-native builders can replicate.
why_clarity: Clearing and accounting rules are codified and outputs reconcile against clearing-house records daily.
why_digital: Software built and delivered electronically to FCMs, sold in enterprise deals.

why_ai: Member representation depends on relationships, though statistics compilation automates.
why_clarity: Monthly statistics recur and check against exchange data; advocacy outcomes are slow.
why_digital: Data compiled and published online, with conferences and lobbying in person.
